name: Richard D. James
research_summary: James studies changes in material structure, especially shape-memory materials, using mathematics at atomic and larger scales. His wider interests include origami-inspired structures, wind-turbine design, superconductivity, and superfluidity, with symmetry helping simplify complex problems.
